critical_rules.store_only: encrypted server-side secret (AES-256-GCM, existing site00_provider_secrets pattern) or a secure secret reference

connection_methods.API_KEY: Providers with an API (fal, openai, xai, anthropic): client pastes key into a server-posted form once → encrypted → never displayed again; REPLACE / DISCONNECT / TEST CONNECTION.
connection_methods.DELEGATED_ACCOUNT (OpenArt today): OpenArt has NO API integration in this repo (usage is manual, ledgers are hand-recorded). SITE 00 must NOT collect the client's OpenArt password. Supported paths: (a) the provider's own team/workspace sharing if it offers one (verify before relying on it), or (b) fall back to CLIENT_REIMBURSED. Balance = MANUALLY ATTESTED snapshot (credits + observed_at + who attested).

record.storage: EXTEND site00_external_connections + site00_provider_secrets + site00_connection_events; add project_id scope to secrets (or link via site00_service_connections.secret_ref); add generation providers to site00_service_catalog
fields: balance_snapshot {credits, usd_equiv, observed_at, source API|ATTESTED} (never keys)

project_firewall: A client-funded connection belongs to ONE project or an explicitly authorized set. AIO credentials can never be used by JURNL, FRONTAL SLAYER, SITE 00 or other clients. Server checks project_id on every generation call; generation endpoints take the connection from the project record, never from the request.
authorization: Client explicitly authorizes SITE 00 to use the provider for this project (checkbox + terms version). Stored: provider_authorization, project_scope, authorized_at, revoked_at.
revocation: Client can DISCONNECT / REVOKE at any time; historical ledger rows stay; in-flight jobs stop; family goes AWAITING_PRODUCTION_FUNDING.
founder_view: CLIENT RELATIONSHIP shows project provider authorization status, last attested balance, spend vs limit.
existing_risks_to_fix_first: client connect-service endpoint lets the client set any connection_state (api/site00/client-production.ts)
